access.notes: Obtain tetragonal unit cell with lattice constants a=8.69 Å, c=13.40 Å from Crystallography Open Database (COD) or Materials Project. If not found, build from space group and atomic positions described in the literature.
Obtain anatase unit cell with lattice constants a=3.776 Å, c=9.486 Å from COD (e.g., ID 5000222) or Materials Project.
Obtain rutile unit cell with lattice constants a=4.594 Å, c=2.959 Å from COD (e.g., ID 9004142) or Materials Project.
Use an open-source DFT package such as Quantum ESPRESSO (pw.x) that supports PAW pseudopotentials, GGA-PBE, and vdW-DF functionals.
Standard PBE PAW pseudopotentials from PSlibrary or SSSP for Sn, I, C, N, H, Ti, O (e.g., Sn.pbe-dn-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF, I.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.0.2.UPF, etc.).
